status: PREREGISTERED — fixed before any embedding score exists. Any change is a new version with supersedes.
question: Does an embedding model with a different failure mode from reasoning models separate G2's EQUIVALENT_DISTINCTION pairs from its DIFFERENT_DISTINCTION pairs? Exploratory: 24 pairs support a comparison, not a reliability claim.

inputs.blind_pairs: experiments/helen_frontier_v0/prereg/pairs_blind.json — generated by make_blind_pairs.py; carries ids and texts only, no label, no justification, no snippet
inputs.texts: temple/autoresearch/outbox/*.json, field order summary > hypothesis > title > finding; read-only

model.expected_revision: main as of 2026-10-06 (hub lastModified). The runner records the resolved snapshot commit sha from the local cache path as OBSERVED; it never trusts a self-reported id.
model.prompt_name: SentenceSimilarity (symmetric task; same prefix on both sides)

preprocessing: text as stored; whitespace collapsed; no template stripping (pairs are free-form by construction); no truncation beyond the model's 8192-token window

scoring_rule.per_pair: report cosine score for all 24 pairs, both dims; primary decision uses 768 only
scoring_rule.separation_statistic: AUC = P(score(EQUIVALENT) > score(DIFFERENT)) over the 12x12 pairings, ties count 0.5; threshold-free; computed once; no threshold is tuned
scoring_rule.disagreement_rule: an EQUIVALENT pair whose score is below the median of ALL 24 scores, or a DIFFERENT pair whose score is above that median, is a DISAGREEMENT with the G2 oracle
scoring_rule.interpretation: a disagreement is a signal to adjudicate, not evidence that either side is right
scoring_rule.pass_fail: none declared; this run produces a table and a list, not a verdict

adjudication.who: a party who did not produce the annotations and did not run the embedding (operator, or a non-Claude model, or a human reader)
adjudication.blinded: adjudicator sees both packet texts and the two positions (G2 label, embedding side), not the justification text, and decides EQUIVALENT / DIFFERENT / UNDECIDABLE with one line
adjudication.output: adjudications.json beside the scored report; counts of oracle-wrong / embedding-wrong / undecidable

receipt_rule.principle: a receipt binds to OBSERVED execution facts; ASSERTED metadata is kept in a separate block and never promoted
unverifiable_fields: runtime_attestation — the host does not attest which weights executed; marked UNVERIFIED

limits_declared_in_advance: 24 pairs from one annotator; no agreement measure; exploratory only
embedding and reasoning models may share training data or blind spots; a different measurement path is not yet an independent witness until provenance is checked
G2 pair 1 justification is factually wrong and pair 5 is disputed by HAL; they stay in the set unchanged, flagged, so the scorer is not tuned by removing inconvenient pairs
